Figures describe Évasion Mont-Blanc, the main pass sold in Megève. Search summary of Megève guides and OnTheSnow: 400 km of slopes, 227–228 runs, 84 lifts; terrain split 19% beginner, 28% intermediate, 39% advanced, 15% expert (OnTheSnow). A by-type list in the same summary (36 chairlifts, 10 gondolas, 105 drag lifts = 151) has a different, wider scope and is not used. Individual lift capacities: Bettex-Arbois gondola 2,400/h, Chamois gondola 1,750/h, new Radaz chairlift (2026) 2,700/h, L'Alpette chairlift 3,000/h. Les Portes du Mont-Blanc (Combloux, Cordon, Le Jaillet, La Giettaz): about 100 km, 23 lifts, 63 pistes.

character: Megève is a traditional Haute-Savoie village known for its upmarket atmosphere, with skiing on Mont d'Arbois, Rochebrune, Le Jaillet and Cote 2000. Its main pass covers Évasion Mont-Blanc (about 400 km and 84 lifts, shared with Saint-Gervais and neighbouring villages), much of it tree-lined terrain at mid altitude; Les Portes du Mont-Blanc (about 100 km) has its own pass.
learning: About 19% of the terrain is rated beginner (OnTheSnow split, search summary). Reference: Megève has several beginner areas near the village; confirm beginner-lift access and lessons for 2026-27.
